_description: PYRO-ASTRA Modeling-Ready Microgravity Combustion Test Runs Dataset
_license_statement: There are no restrictions on the use of this data. (Registry of Open Data on AWS, https://registry.opendata.aws/nasa-psi/)

_rules_enforced.G1_strict_nulls: All unmeasured or unstated fields are strictly null. No interpolation, extrapolation or estimation.
_rules_enforced.G1_row_provenance: Every row carries authentic {file, sha256, row_id, column, unit_conversion_note}.
_rules_enforced.G1_exact_unit_conversions: Exact mathematical formulas: 1 atm = 14.6959 psi, 1 mmHg = 14.6959/760 psi, 1 bar = 14.50377 psi, 1.0 mole frac O2 = 100%.
_rules_enforced.G1_oxygen_isolation: Burner feed oxygen (CFI-G) strictly isolated in burner_flow_o2_pct; cabin_o2_pct is strictly null for burner flames.
_rules_enforced.G1_zero_partial_gravity: Gravity regime strictly microgravity or 1g ground comparator. Zero partial-gravity predictions. Electric field analog tagged as electric-field-analog.
